From the table

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

A courtyard in Aradippou

To Kazani is a traditional tavern at 28th October Street 5 in Aradippou, a women-owned business with blue and white gingham on the tables, blue shutters and a courtyard. Meze is the way to eat here, minimum two.

Open Monday to Saturday from six in the evening until one, closed on Sunday.
